before_gateway:
set -eu; d=/etc/systemd/system; printf '[Unit]
Description=Orbit Gateway automatic release
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/true
' > $d/orbit-gateway-release.service; printf '[Unit]
Description=Orbit Gateway release %%i
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/true
' > $d/orbit-gateway-release-run@.service; printf '[Unit]
Description=Orbit Gateway automatic release timer
[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* *:*:00
Unit=orbit-gateway-release.service
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
' > $d/orbit-gateway-release.timer; systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable --now orbit-gateway-release.timer
